The Subtask Name: Determine the directors of the films and their birth years

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed targeted searches to identify the directors and birth years of both films.
  -- Observation: Retrieved information from various sources such as Wikipedia and IMDb.
  -- Thought: Compared the birth years of the directors to determine who was born earlier.
  -- Result: Identified Bertrand Blier (Buffet Froid) born in 1939 and Stewart Raffill (Lost In Africa) born in 1932.

- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Analyzed the results and determined the final comparison.
  -- Observation: Compared the birth years to identify the film with the earlier-born director.
  -- Thought: Concluded that Stewart Raffill was born earlier than Bertrand Blier.
  -- Result: Determined that "Lost In Africa" has the director born earlier.
